WITH scoped_tenants AS (
  SELECT id, name FROM tenants
  WHERE name IN ('Ballycorran Industrial Supply','Castell Fasteners','Hanse Industriebedarf','Midland Safety Wear','Polder Packaging')
),
new_business_pipelines AS (
  SELECT p.id AS pipeline_id, p.tenant_id
  FROM pipelines p
  JOIN scoped_tenants st ON st.id = p.tenant_id
  WHERE p.name = 'New business'
),
lost_opps AS (
  SELECT o.id AS opportunity_id, o.tenant_id, o.created_at, o.closed_at
  FROM opportunities o
  JOIN new_business_pipelines nbp ON nbp.pipeline_id = o.pipeline_id AND nbp.tenant_id = o.tenant_id
  WHERE o.is_closed = true AND o.is_won = false
),
total_lost AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_lost_opps FROM lost_opps
),
activity_positions AS (
  SELECT
    a.id AS activity_id,
    lo.opportunity_id,
    CASE
      WHEN lo.closed_at IS NULL OR lo.created_at IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN lo.closed_at = lo.created_at THEN NULL
      ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.occurred_at - lo.created_at)) / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (lo.closed_at - lo.created_at))
    END AS relative_position
  FROM activities a
  JOIN lost_opps lo ON lo.opportunity_id = a.opportunity_id AND a.tenant_id = lo.tenant_id
),
bucketed AS (
  SELECT
    activity_id,
    opportunity_id,
    CASE
      WHEN relative_position IS NULL OR relative_position < 0 OR relative_position > 1 THEN 'outside window'
      WHEN relative_position < 0.25 THEN 'Q1 (0-25%)'
      WHEN relative_position < 0.5 THEN 'Q2 (25-50%)'
      WHEN relative_position < 0.75 THEN 'Q3 (50-75%)'
      ELSE 'Q4 (75-100%)'
    END AS lifecycle_quartile
  FROM activity_positions
),
totals AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_activities_all FROM bucketed
)
SELECT
  b.lifecycle_quartile,
  COUNT(*) AS total_activities_in_bucket,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / t.total_activities_all, 2) AS pct_of_total_activities,
  COUNT(DISTINCT b.opportunity_id) AS opportunities_with_at_least_one_activity_in_bucket,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT b.opportunity_id) / tl.total_lost_opps, 2) AS pct_of_lost_opportunities_with_activity_in_bucket
FROM bucketed b
CROSS JOIN totals t
CROSS JOIN total_lost tl
GROUP BY b.lifecycle_quartile, t.total_activities_all, tl.total_lost_opps
ORDER BY CASE b.lifecycle_quartile
  WHEN 'Q1 (0-25%)' THEN 1
  WHEN 'Q2 (25-50%)' THEN 2
  WHEN 'Q3 (50-75%)' THEN 3
  WHEN 'Q4 (75-100%)' THEN 4
  ELSE 5
END
note: Scoped to the 5 named tenants' 'New business' pipeline, opportunities with is_closed=true and is_won=false. Activities with null/zero-duration relative position, or outside [0,1], are grouped into an 'outside window' bucket per the spec; pct_of_lost_opportunities uses a fixed denominator (total lost opportunities in scope) across all rows.
